mapper.insert: INSERT INTO generated_report(template_id, user_id, report_title, parameters, content, documentUrl, file_path, status, create_time) VALUES(#{templateId}, #{userId}, #{reportTitle}, #{parameters}, #{content}, #{documentUrl}, #{filePath}, #{status}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, template_id, user_id, report_title, parameters, content, documentUrl, file_path, download_count, status, create_time, complete_time FROM generated_report WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, template_id, user_id, report_title, parameters, content, documentUrl, file_path, download_count, status, create_time, complete_time FROM generated_report WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
